title: Bus Routes
problemStatement: You are given several bus routes where each route is represented as a list of bus stops visited repeatedly in a cycle. Starting from the source stop, determine the minimum number of buses you must take to reach the target stop. If it is impossible to reach the destination, return -1.
input: Integer r r arrays representing bus routes Integer source Integer target
output: A single integer representing the minimum number of buses required.
constraints: 1 <= r <= 500 Total number of bus stops across all routes does not exceed 10^5 0 <= source, target <= 10^6
